verdict.rationale: Scheduling recurring jobs is a fair automation question for a terminal emulator, but the evidence shows no built-in scheduler or recurring-workflow feature in kitty. The remote-control API and scripting (kitten @ send-text, verified hands-on) are developer building blocks that would need an external scheduler such as cron. Startup sessions are a one-off launch configuration, not a recurring schedule, so neither earns credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
